role: The abstract tile-entity-provider base: marks its subclasses as containers and removes the tile entity when the block breaks; forwards client events to the tile entity.

members.name: BlockContainer
members.note: isBlockContainer becomes the registry's tile_entity flag (harvestdrops.c:407 names it).

members.name: onBlockAdded
members.note: The super call only; the per-class bodies (chest facing, furnace, dispenser) run from the blockcb dispatch.

members.name: breakBlock
members.note: world.c:1211-1221: the breakBlock tail removes the tile entity.

members.name: onBlockEventReceived
members.note: The generic receiveClientEvent route is not ported; the chest lid and note block behaviors reach tileticks.c by their own paths.; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

notes: The tile_entity flag drives silk-touch exclusion (dig.c:395, harvestdrops.c:405) and the tile entity registry (tileentity.c:te_kind_of_block). Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): onBlockEventReceived's server half changes no state for any reachable container. Formerly listed as missing: BlockContainer.onBlockEventReceived's forwarding to TileEntity.receiveClientEvent has no native counterpart; the effects that need it (the chest lid, the note block pitch) are handled inside tileticks.c instead.
